heading: Controller paths
body: RequestRoute marks a controller and sets its base path. Put the class in server/controllers/NameController.ext. GetRoute answers GET requests. PostRoute answers POST requests. PutRoute answers PUT requests. PatchRoute answers PATCH requests. DeleteRoute answers DELETE requests. StreamRoute answers GET requests with a stream of server-sent events: the method yields each message, and StreamRequest on a client receives them. Each method path follows the class path. Start the method name with its verb: getItem, GetItem or get_item, and streamTicks, StreamTicks or stream_ticks for StreamRoute. ResponseStatus sets a successful response status, such as 201. Public, SignedIn and Allow(Role) say who may call a route: anyone, any signed-in user, or only users with one of these roles. Write one on the class or on the method; the method wins, and a route without one stops the build. IdentityProvider marks the one class that says who is signed in.
